column1: # c7 v6: virou pintura realista de natureza-morta. Tirar textura de madeira, poeira e brilho; ficar com duas formas planas.

column7: Drawn illustration, comic book line art: clean black contour outlines, flat colour areas, shading in a few hard cel steps. A wooden shelf, drawn as one flat brown plane with a single black line for its edge. On it, a thick hardcover book with a gilded spine standing upright, and beside it a thin stapled paper booklet. Both drawn as flat geometric shapes with heavy black outlines. Plain dark background, no texture, no dust, no wood grain, no highlights.
